@graph.name: OSDR Multi-Crop Space Agriculture Meta-Analysis: Lettuce and Mizuna on ISS
@graph.description: Comparative cross-species meta-analysis of spaceflight-grown leafy greens (Lettuce and Mizuna mustard) under NASA OSDR studies OSD-745, OSD-655, and OSD-780. Includes elemental composition (ICP-OES), biochemical assays (phenolics, anthocyanins, ORAC), microbial safety plate counts (APC, YMC), Random Forest, TabPFN models, SHAP interpretability, and statistical validation.

@graph.name: Combined Multi-Crop Meta-Analysis Dataset
@graph.description: Harmonized master dataset combining elemental composition, phenolic content, anthocyanin content, ORAC values, and microbiological plate counts for both Lettuce (OSD-745) and Mizuna (OSD-655/OSD-780) across 5 ISS missions.

@graph.name: Lettuce-only Curation Dataset
@graph.description: Harmonized Lettuce-only dataset for backwards compatibility.

@graph.name: Multi-Crop ML Meta-Analysis Pipeline
@graph.description: Python script performing joint PCA, Random Forest and TabPFN classification (LOMOCV and LOCOCV), SHAP feature importance, and non-parametric statistical testing with FDR/Bonferroni corrections.

@graph.name: Interactive Multi-Crop Dashboard
@graph.description: Static client-side web application for exploring crop-specific nutritional profiles, growth galleries, and comparative machine learning benchmarks.

@graph.name: LaTeX Manuscript
@graph.description: Modular LaTeX manuscript detailing the space biology multi-crop meta-analysis, compiling to PDF.

@graph.name: Data Dictionary
@graph.description: Machine-readable schema documenting every column in the master meta-analysis CSV with data types, units, assay methods, and instrumentation.
